Class TimeConverter

Namespace
SilverCraft.CSCore
Assembly
SilverCraft.CSCore.dll

Defines a base class for all time converts. A time converter can be used to convert raw positions (depending on the implementation i.e. bytes or samples) to a human readable TimeSpan.
